crime: Every evening in the lounge, one girl braided the hair of every girl there, the way she had braided her little sisters' hair every night at home. Each time, she held the brush out to {WITCH_NAME}. Each time, {WITCH_NAME} snapped, "Don't come near me," and turned away.
Whenever it rained, {WITCH_NAME} stood alone among the trees at the far end of the courtyard. Her Magic stopped the rain above her, and she came back inside dry.
One evening at dusk, before the rain, the girl came out with her brush and sat down at the edge of the space {WITCH_NAME} kept around herself. "Everyone's braided mine but you," she said.
As the rain began, {WITCH_NAME} let her inside that edge. No one had ever been let so near. The girl laid her long braid in {WITCH_NAME}'s hands and shut her eyes. "I'm not scared of you."

At twelve, brushing her mother's long hair at the dressing table, {WITCH_NAME} had pictured winding it round her mother's throat. She told her mother. By morning, her mother had cut off her own hair and locked herself in her room.
In the rain, {WITCH_NAME} wound the braid round the girl's throat and pulled until the girl was still.

As the rain stopped, the prisoners saw {WITCH_NAME} walk into the lounge, dry. She sat among them until the body was found. Forty minutes after the rain, they found the girl dead in the courtyard grass, her hair and clothes dry.

In the trial court, the prisoners concluded that the girl had gone out after the rain, while {WITCH_NAME} sat with them. But the prisoner who lifted the body had found the grass beneath it dry, though the whole courtyard was soaked. Then they understood. The girl had been lying there the whole time it rained, and {WITCH_NAME}'s Magic had kept every drop off her.
fields.epitaph: She held back the rain, every hand, everyone. Never once the picture.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Kept Everyone Out of Reach of Her Own Hands
execution: A dressing table rose, as tall as the trial court. She sat chained before its mirror. A pair of shears hung open at her neck, one blade on either side.
The shears closed and cropped her hair at the jaw. They kept closing until the blades met at her throat.
She hung still between the closed blades, her shorn head bowed in the glass.

magic.name: Arm's Length
magic.text: Anything coming toward her stops at the distance she sets, unless she lets it near.
